Bank of America Arm to Invest $1.9 Billion in Jio Credit

Bank of America's arm will acquire a 49.9% stake in Jio Credit for ₹18,300 crore ($1.9 billion). This investment signifies a major confidence boost in India's expanding retail lending market. The partnership aims to combine Jio's digital innovation with Bank of America's financial expertise to drive growth in India.
